description:
Create OpenAI-powered playlists in Qobuz, Tidal, Apple Music and Spotify

Describe your ideal playlist, and with the power of OpenAI create your playlists in your favorite streaming service.
What's Changed
- Portable Windows binary in releases; drop the Node 20 action by @platten in #16
- Add a GitHub Pages landing site by @platten in #17
- Drop the inline playlist list from the Create page by @platten in #19
- Health-check streaming sessions and prompt to reconnect by @platten in #20
- Document streaming import, reconnect prompts, and the Browse picker by @platten in #21
- Fit the Create page without a scrollbar by @platten in #22
- Document opening the unsigned macOS build past Gatekeeper by @platten in #23
